## How you checked it

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm example:vite` pass
- [ ] Tried in Light, Dark and Glass
- [ ] Tried at 320px wide
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader behavior still work (or are improved)
- [ ] No reader-facing text under 13px, no native `title` tooltips, no colored left-edge bars
- [ ] If the package contents changed on purpose, ran `pnpm snapshot:tarball`

## Public API

- [ ] No change to the public API
- [ ] Adds to the public API (minor)
- [ ] Changes or removes public API (major; please explain why above)

Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`); see CONTRIBUTING.md.
